approaches.name: satellite, smartphone and geo-enabled platforms for remote road supervision
approaches.description: Uses satellite imagery, smartphone roughness surveys, GEMS geo-location and RSSAT screening to supervise and design road works remotely. Practices: satellite imagery and smartphone road-condition data for remote supervision; GEMS geo-enabled monitoring and supervision platform; Road Safety Screening and Appraisal Tool for road design.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: remote digital supervision replacing site visits - cue: 'smart approaches' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: Due to the large project area, the volatile security situation in the Sahelian strip, and the impact of COVID-19, the project will rely on a variety of smart approaches leveraging digital technologies to facilitate the implementation of project activities, consultation process, as well as enhance monitoring and evaluation.

extra_evidence.text: The activities will include, but are not limited to: (a) direct remote monitoring using satellite imagery;
(b) use of smartphones for road data collection (such as road roughness before and after the civil works);
(c) mobile-based iterative beneficiary monitoring mechanisms; and (d) geo-enabling initiative for monitoring and supervision (GEMS).
The Road Safety Screening and Appraisal Tool (RSSAT) was applied to assess the road safety impact of the proposed rehabilitation of the Tanout - Tiguidit section.

Given the lack of relevant granular data, efforts focused on collecting, verifying, processing and coding data from various possible sources and based on good practices (e.g. using the engineering pre-feasibility design studies, the most up-to-date road traffic injuries, WHO estimates (2018) and available traffic data).

category.rationale: Technological: remote sensing and mobile data collection are the core mechanism

sector.rationale: Remote supervision of road works directly supports road construction quality.
